description:
DECISION (user, 2026-07-11): delete the resume machinery and lean on
datagen-reuse making restarts cheap, rather than hardening it.

Why deletion is the right call -- the resume path was verified fragile in
four independent ways on develop @ fc31f3604:
(a) load_resume_attempts (tests/uat/orchestrator.py:70-81) checks neither
    manifest version nor config_name nor commit -- resuming with a
    different config or on different code silently replays stale records;
(b) replayed passed cells never verify result_path still exists;
(c) the manifest is written only for free-space aborts (orchestrator.py
    :263-272, :310-317, :346-354, all gated on the prose string
    `"free space" in abort_reason`) -- docker/validate/package aborts were
    never resumable anyway;
(d) `--resume` is unreachable from the documented make surface (no
    RESUME= passthrough at Makefile:2206/:2224).

Deletion scope: _write_resume_manifest, load_resume_attempts,
build_resume_runner, RESUME_MANIFEST_VERSION (orchestrator.py),
`--resume` flags on the sweep and execute subparsers (_cli.py:504, :566)
and their handler branches (_cli.py:78-79, :409-413), resume-manifest
sections in _project/specs/uat-framework.md (Section 3 "Resume manifest",
Section 9.4) and docs/operations/uat-framework.md, and the resume-runner
tests in test_orchestrator.py / test_runner.py.

KEPT AND HARDENED -- the abort-safe provenance artifacts (#691) stay; the
restart story becomes "rerun the config; datagen reuse + ladder pruning
make it cheap". Two durability defects in those artifacts get fixed here
because resume's deletion makes the artifacts the ONLY record:

1. SAME-DAY EVIDENCE DESTRUCTION: default log dirs are date-granular
   (`uat_{date}`, config.py:55, execute.py:758-763) and every durable
   artifact is opened mode "w" (cells.jsonl orchestrator.py:579, sidecar
   :576-578, compatibility_pruned.jsonl :609-625, matrix_summary TSV).
   A second same-day run of the same config silently overwrites the first
   run's evidence.

2. NO ATOMIC WRITES ANYWHERE: every artifact is written in place. A crash
   mid-write leaves torn JSON/TSV; the sidecar is written before
   cells.jsonl so a crash between the two leaves a fresh sidecar beside a
   stale cell stream, and `make uat-report` will combine them.

work_units.notes:
Deleted _write_resume_manifest, load_resume_attempts, build_resume_runner,
RESUME_MANIFEST_VERSION, and the ResumeAttempts alias from
tests/uat/orchestrator.py, along with the now-dead `attempted`/manifest
branches in run_sweep (the preflight-abort branch's manifest write was
unreachable dead code -- execute never runs before a preflight abort).
Removed --resume from both the sweep and execute argparse subparsers and
their handlers in tests/uat/_cli.py. Renamed
_build_disk_floor_runner's attempted_for_resume param to attempted_cells
since it is still needed for abort-artifact emission independent of
resume. Removed the now-unused `cell_key` import and `_optional_path`
helper. Replaced the two resume-manifest-asserting tests in
test_orchestrator.py with resume-free versions
(test_disk_floor_abort_emits_partial_artifacts,
test_execute_free_space_abort_emits_partial_artifacts) that keep
covering the #691 abort-safe-artifact-emission contract; deleted
test_manifest_runner_reuses_attempted_cells_and_runs_complement outright
(tested a function that no longer exists). Scrubbed resume-manifest
sections from _project/specs/uat-framework.md (Section 3 block,
Section 9.4 -- folded 9.5 down to 9.4, "four classes" -> "three
classes"), docs/operations/uat-framework.md (heading + resume-with
instructions + the four-classes list), and tests/uat/README.md. No hard
removal shim; --resume now fails argparse with an "unrecognized
arguments" error. No RESUME= passthrough existed in the Makefile to
remove (confirmed via grep). Makefile's unrelated release-cut "resume"
terminology (a different feature) was left untouched.
work_units.summary: Delete resume machinery: orchestrator functions + manifest writes, --resume CLI flags and handler branches, resume tests; scrub resume mentions from spec and operator docs

work_units.notes:
Added atomic_write_text(path, text) to tests/uat/phases/report.py (temp
sibling via with_name(name + ".tmp"), fsync, os.replace, parent mkdir).
Placed it there rather than orchestrator.py to avoid a circular import:
orchestrator.py already imports report.py, and validate.py now imports
report.py too, so report.py stays the acyclic leaf both depend on.
Threaded it through all five write sites: _write_cells_jsonl and
_write_compatibility_pruned_jsonl in orchestrator.py (rewritten to build
content as a string/list-join instead of writing to an open handle),
run_validate's validator_rollup.tsv write in phases/validate.py (was
already a single write_text call, swapped directly), and write_report's
matrix_summary TSV in phases/report.py (rewritten to build a `lines`
list, joined and written once at the end). Content is byte-identical to
the prior mode="w" writes -- verified via the existing content-asserting
tests (JSONL field checks, TSV footer checks) all still passing
unmodified. Added 3 new tests in test_phases.py covering the helper
directly: write+cleanup-of-.tmp, overwrite semantics, and that a
simulated os.replace failure leaves the previous good artifact
untouched (no torn write).
work_units.summary: Add temp-file+os.replace atomic writes for cells.jsonl, accounting sidecar, compatibility_pruned.jsonl, validator_rollup.tsv, matrix_summary TSV (single shared helper in tests/uat/)

work_units.notes:
Changed the OutputConfig dataclass default and the config-loader
fallback in tests/uat/config.py from "uat_{date}" to "uat_{date}_{time}".
default_log_dir() in tests/uat/phases/execute.py now also expands
{time} -> HHMMSS from the `now` passed in (or datetime.now()). str
.replace is a no-op when a placeholder is absent, so all 32 checked-in
configs with an explicit {date}-only logs_dir_template (verified by
grep) keep rendering identically -- confirmed by a new
test_default_log_dir_explicit_date_only_template_still_works test.
Added test_default_log_dir_substitutes_time_component and
test_default_log_dir_time_avoids_same_day_collision (unit-level, in
test_phases.py) plus an orchestrator-level
test_two_sweeps_in_one_process_land_in_distinct_log_dirs in
test_orchestrator.py that mocks datetime.now with two distinct
same-day values across two run_sweep() calls and asserts the resulting
log dirs differ (deterministic, not timing-dependent -- avoids
same-wall-clock-second flakiness in a fast test loop).
work_units.summary: Make default run dirs collision-free: the default log-dir template gains a time component; test that two same-day sweeps land in distinct dirs

work_units.notes:
Reordered _write_cells_jsonl in orchestrator.py: the cell-stream content
is now built and atomic_write_text'd to cells.jsonl before the
accounting sidecar is computed and written. Added
test_write_cells_jsonl_writes_cell_stream_before_accounting_sidecar,
which wraps report_phase.atomic_write_text with a recording wrapper
(still delegating to the real implementation) and asserts the call
order is [cells.jsonl, sidecar].
work_units.summary: Write cells.jsonl before its accounting sidecar (reverse current order) so a crash between the two cannot leave a fresh sidecar beside a stale stream; add an ordering test
